description: Create a redirect for a blog. Requires owner or admin access through account-level OAuth or a user-scoped API key.

active.description: Whether this redirect should be applied.

blogId.description: Blog ID. Use list_blogs to discover available blog IDs.

destination.description: Destination site path or absolute HTTP(S) URL.

source_path.description: Incoming site path to redirect, starting with a single /. Query strings and fragments are not allowed.

status_code.description: HTTP redirect status code. Use 301 for permanent redirects and 302 for temporary redirects.

name: create_redirect
title: Create redirect
